aria2.note: Not measured: a faithful comparison requires a live aria2c daemon with an active GID on a throttled URI; pause/unpause on a nonexistent GID would return instantly and understate real control-plane cost. The diagnosis doc records ~150 ms for this path.

methodology.honesty: No warm-cache hit is presented as a general speedup. Native values are null until the PyO3 extension is built and this script is re-run.
methodology.peak_rss: ru_maxrss of an isolated worker subprocess after one transfer
methodology.recycle: in-process recycle_connections() wall time after >=64 KiB of throttled progress; native only (see aria2 note in results).
methodology.startup: cold import in a fresh subprocess (median of 3)
methodology.throughput: 32 MiB deterministic loopback payload, 16 connections; cold run (first invocation) and warm median (3 runs) reported separately. Loopback measures local CPU/socket cost, NOT WAN anti-throttle performance.
